scenes.say: Every great dinner is a small miracle. Someone makes it happen.

sfx.text: soft warm restaurant ambience, distant murmur of diners, one gentle cutlery chime

scenes.say: Friday, seven-forty. Twelve tables, one tray, and a hundred tiny things that mustn't be forgotten.

sfx.text: busy restaurant kitchen clatter, pans and plates, quick and rhythmic, short

scenes.say: Then, the water never arrives. Nobody's fault. Just a very human, very busy night.

sfx.text: a single wine glass clink followed by a soft comedic oops slide-down tone

scenes.say: Meet TableMate. A quiet friend on your phone, whispering the next three moves. Suggestions, never orders.

sfx.text: three soft gentle notification chimes ascending, clean and friendly

scenes.say: Allergy on table four? It catches that before the plate leaves the pass. Some mistakes can't be taken back.

sfx.text: soft alert ping then a reassuring success chime

scenes.say: And when things run late, it tells the truth: floor, or kitchen. No blame games. Just clarity.
Managers get the whole room at a glance. Flow, not scoreboards. Support, never surveillance.

sfx.text: soft digital ding with a gentle shimmer

scenes.say: Dreading a tough guest? Rehearse it first, privately, with a coach who actually talks back.

sfx.text: two soft chat message pops, one sent one received

scenes.say: In your language. On your phone. For everyone on the team.

sfx.text: warm friendly chime, bright and short

scenes.say: TableMate. Be there for every guest.

sfx.text: gentle bell sparkle resolving on a warm major chord
